hypothesis: If batrachians are absent from oceanic islands, no native amphibian species is recorded on strictly oceanic (never land-connected) islands.
pass_criterion: Zero native amphibian species are recorded on a predefined list of oceanic islands or archipelagos: Hawaii, Azores, Galápagos, Canary Islands, Madeira, St Helena, Ascension, Tristan da Cunha, Mauritius, Réunion and Bermuda.
fail_criterion: At least one native (non-introduced) amphibian species is recorded on any island or archipelago in that list, confirmed by the species account.
interpretation: 'Oceanic island' means an island of volcanic or coral origin that has never been connected to a continent. Land-bridge or continental fragments (Madagascar, New Zealand, Seychelles, New Guinea) are excluded. 'Strictly true' is read as zero exceptions. Introduced species are excluded using the species' native-range text.

dataset.name: AmphibiaWeb
dataset.why_it_fits: AmphibiaWeb gives species accounts with country and region distribution and native-range text. Search by country or island and read the distribution fields to check native status.
